const svg=root.querySelector('svg'),format=root.querySelector('[data-format]'),power=root.querySelector('[data-power]'),status=root.querySelector('[role=status]');const glyphs=['01110100011001110101110011000101110','00100011000010000100001000010001110','01110100010000100010001000100011111','11110000010000101110000010000111110','00010001100101010010111110001000010','11111100001000011110000010000111110','01110100001000011110100011000101110','11111000010001000100010000100001000','01110100011000101110100011000101110','01110100011000101111000010000101110'];let on=true,twelve=false;function render(){const now=new Date(),h=now.getHours();const value=String(twelve?(h%12||12):h).padStart(2,'0')+String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');let s='';for(let d=0;d<4;d++){for(let i=0;i<35;i++){const lit=on&&glyphs[+value[d]][i]==='1';s+='<circle cx="'+(7+d*34+(d>1?8:0)+(i%5)*5)+'" cy="'+(6+Math.floor(i/5)*5)+'" r="1.45" fill="'+(lit?'#e99c73':'#292b29')+'"/>'}}s+='<circle cx="74" cy="15" r="1.5" fill="'+(on?'#e99c73':'#292b29')+'"/><circle cx="74" cy="27" r="1.5" fill="'+(on?'#e99c73':'#292b29')+'"/>';svg.innerHTML=s;svg.setAttribute('aria-label',on?value.slice(0,2)+':'+value.slice(2):'Display off');root.dataset.power=on?'on':'off'}format.onclick=()=>{twelve=!twelve;format.textContent=twelve?'12h':'24h';format.setAttribute('aria-label','Switch to '+(twelve?'24':'12')+'-hour time');status.textContent=twelve?'12-hour time':'24-hour time';render()};power.onclick=()=>{on=!on;power.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));status.textContent=on?'Clock on':'Clock off';render()};render();const timer=setInterval(()=>{if(!root.isConnected){clearInterval(timer);return}render()},1000);
return function(){clearInterval(timer)};
